title: Enemy Spotted
blurb: A flat professional voice, belonging to a man who is about to be one-tapped through a doorway. Counter-Strike's radio callouts were designed for clarity rather than character, and that is how they ended up so quotable. Nobody in real life announces a threat this calmly. Play it when a teacher walks into the room, when an ex arrives at the party, or when the group chat's main character comes online with something to say. Gaming's most reusable alert: threat detected, situational awareness engaged, best of luck to everyone involved.
origin: The classic radio callout from Counter-Strike.
